comment: Point lights (PointLights.cs; GDD, 'Jour et nuit'): their intensity × dayShare in full day, × 1 at the darkest of the night (DayNight.Darkness). Each glow: color, radius (tiles), intensity, flicker (share of the intensity that wavers). pokemonTypes: by type of the Pokémon (ROM type ids), pokemon: by id, before the types; moves: projectiles of that type, and a flash of flashTime seconds where they hit; obstacles / terrains: by key, one light per block of lavaGrid × lavaGrid tiles holding some; brazier, caveMark, caveMouth, stairs, arc, firefly: the sealed caves' braziers, mark and open mouth, the island's stairs, the pylons' active arc, fireflies (AmbientParticles, `light` of an effect). Only within range tiles of the camera, at most maxLights at once (the nearest).
